name: Lease depth, core to facade (sample)
question: How deep is the floor from the core to the facade on the short side, which drives daylight and fit-out?
method: Assumes a square core centred on the plate, as Tower Design Toolkit models it, and takes half of what is left on the shorter side: (shorter side − core side) ÷ 2.
human: Whether a deeper plan suits the use (trading floors, labs) or needs atria, light wells or a different core position.
limits: A sample package for the development registry: the thresholds are team presets, not a sourced daylight criterion (research P02-M06, floor-plate depth-to-window screen, has the sourced criteria). Off-centre or split cores are not modelled.

metrics.label: Lease depth, core face to facade (short side)

source.label: Sample registry entry: a team preset for demonstration, not a sourced daylight criterion
source.page: See research P02-M06 for sourced criteria

metrics.note: Uses the shorter side, so it is the shallowest of the four sides.
